competitiveTarget: Beat generic brokerage team pages: real broker names, direct-broker accountability, transparent-PNG headshots, and verified Google reviews, inside the KB chrome.
note: Phase 9 KB migration. Team index uses KB chrome (KbNav, KbHero, KbAbout, KbTeam, KbTestimonials, KbSell, FAQBlock, KbFooter, KbSectionTracker). No fabricated stats, rankings, or review text. getBrokers() is the sole broker-data source and now feeds the KbAbout verified-license ledger (restored from the pre-KB BrokerProfileRow). TESTIMONIALS/getReviews feed KbTestimonials. FAQBlock restores the pre-KB agent-choice intent FAQ + FAQPage JSON-LD. Per-broker profiles at /team/[slug] each carry filtered reviews (reviewBelongsOnPage) and getBrokerSales track records inside the same KB chrome.

requiredComponents.name: KbNav
requiredComponents.section: site chrome — KB top bar (replaces default SiteHeader on this route)

requiredComponents.name: KbHero
requiredComponents.section: hero — full-bleed hero with Old Mill poster and direct-broker headline

requiredComponents.name: KbAbout
requiredComponents.section: intro prose — direct-broker accountability copy + verified Oregon license ledger (restored from pre-KB BrokerProfileRow; getBrokers() data, no fabricated stats)

requiredComponents.name: KbTeam
requiredComponents.section: broker grid — three portrait cards, each linking to /team/[slug]

requiredComponents.name: KbTestimonials
requiredComponents.section: social proof — verified Google reviews from getReviews() or TESTIMONIALS

requiredComponents.name: FAQBlock
requiredComponents.section: agent-choice intent FAQ — restored from the pre-KB /team page; shared FAQBlock emits FAQPage JSON-LD (same pattern as the community KB page)

requiredComponents.name: KbFooter
requiredComponents.section: site chrome — KB footer (replaces default SiteFooter on this route)

perBrokerPage.note: Per-broker profile page shares the same KB chrome. Key invariants: (1) reviewBelongsOnPage() filters every review — a broker's page never shows another broker's named review. (2) getBrokerSales() provides per-broker closings (both sides); fallback is getBrokerageListingTiles() brokerage record. (3) JSON-LD RealEstateAgent + BreadcrumbList preserved. (4) KbHero poster = broker headshot. (5) KbAbout = verified bio + license + closings facts. (6) KbFeatured = track-record tiles. (7) KbTestimonials = filtered reviews.

requiredComponents.name: KbAbout
requiredComponents.section: bio — verified broker bio + quick facts

requiredComponents.name: KbFeatured
requiredComponents.section: track record — own sales or brokerage record
